run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
create_gtn_loss_function: create a custom PyTorch autograd function using GTN graphs for sequence-level loss computation
build_target_graph: build a target graph where each token can align to one or more input frames
compute_forward_score: compute the forward score of intersected target and emissions graphs using gtn.forward_score
compute_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for GTN loss using gtn.backward and parallel_for
